# Real Section

An inline tag is prose, so the line below it is NOT a heading.

<span>inline</span>
# Not A Heading — Inline Tag

A real HTML block is not, and the heading below it IS real.

<div>
inner
</div>
# Below A Div

A `<pre>` block is CommonMark condition 1, and Session 183's gate deleted this one.

<pre>
code
</pre>
# Below A Pre Block

A footnote definition absorbs the line below it as its own body.

[^1]: a footnote body
# Not A Heading — Footnote

A link-reference definition renders to nothing, so the heading below it is real.

[x]: http://example.com
# Below A Link Reference

An inline TeX macro carries arguments and stays inside a paragraph.

\textbf{bold}
# Not A Heading — Inline TeX

A bare macro alone on its line is a raw TeX block.

\clearpage
# Below A Bare Macro

A comment with trailing content leaves that content as prose.

<!-- a --> tail
# Not A Heading — Comment With Tail

A line that is nothing but comments renders to nothing.

<!-- a --><!-- b -->
# Below An All-Comment Line

An empty bullet marker really is block-level, whatever it looks like.

+
# Below A Lone Plus
